definitions.explanation: A button used to open or close doors, especially on elevators, trains, and automatic doors. Often appears as a pair: 開 (open) and 閉 (close).

examples.japanese: ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開閉|かいへい}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}した→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: I pressed the elevator door button.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開閉|かいへい}ボタン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}している→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧。
examples.english: The door open/close button is out of order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開閉|かいへい}ボタン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冬場|ふゆば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}らない→入る：00494_hairu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{操作|そうさ}する→操作する：18999_sousasuru⟧⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧になっている。
examples.english: Train door buttons are designed so that passengers operate them themselves, to prevent cold air from coming in during winter.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{開閉|かいへい}→開閉：06610_kaihei⟧ (opening and closing) + ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧ (button, from Portuguese/English). Commonly encountered in daily life in Japan, especially on elevators and semi-automatic train doors in rural areas where passengers press a button to open the door.

On Japanese elevators, the buttons are typically marked {開|ひらく} (◁▷) and {閉|とじる} (▷◁). Many people find the similar-looking symbols confusing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開閉|かいへい}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to press the open/close button
- ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開閉|かいへい}ボタン: elevator door button
- ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開閉|かいへい}ボタン: door open/close button
- {開閉|かいへい}ボタン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}かない→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the button doesn't work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧: open button — specifically the "open" button
- ⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧: close button — specifically the "close" button
- ⟦{押|お}しボタン→押しボタン：20483_oshibotan⟧: push button — a general term for any button you press
